subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Secret Wars
email_body:
Hi Joe,

I came across Secret Wars: An Espionage Story and your background as a former CIA covert action officer, which gives the book a distinctive foundation among espionage thrillers.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Secret Wars is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, and it would be a purely optional add-on to the feature. We would shape the visuals around the story and the intelligence world you know so well.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Secret Wars best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
